behavior_case.title: Certified material and safe charge window authorize reactor charge
behavior_case.summary: Domain-only behavior case for plant process-control authorization. Simulator, HMI, PLC, ERP, and codegen surfaces are overlay data.

notes: These are accepted semantic facts; simulator traces and PLC code refs live in the tooling overlay.

when.label: Ask whether the batch can be cleared for reactor charge

expected_outcomes: The material certificate is transported to the batch.
The simulation supports the charge action.
The interlock allows the charge action.
The batch is cleared for reactor charge in the accepted world.
notes: This behavior case can drive service tests and coverage reports, but not direct PLC mutation.
The domain model remains representation-only; fDDD/tooling overlays drive engineering workflows.
